spectrograph-stability.hook: The useful question is not whether the controller is happy. It is whether the optical measurement is more trustworthy.
spectrograph-stability.caption: Conceptual view of an enclosed optical bench. The layout is illustrative, not a photograph or optical prescription of EXOhSPEC.
glossary: Plant
The physical system the controller acts on, including its delays.
Sensitivity
How much of a disturbance remains after feedback.
Out-of-loop sensor
An independent check that the controller is not directly optimising.
Wind-up
Accumulated integral demand while an actuator is unable to deliver more.

gaia-stellar-populations.hook: A colour-magnitude diagram is a population picture. It is not a single star's route through life.
gaia-stellar-populations.caption: Conceptual stellar-population artwork. The catalogue plots in the article use actual Gaia DR3 rows.
glossary: Colour index
The difference between two band magnitudes, not a direct temperature measurement.
Absolute magnitude
Brightness expressed at a standard distance of ten parsecs.
Extinction
Dimming and reddening by material along the line of sight.
Selection function
The probability an object enters the sample, given its properties and location.

neid-quality-cuts.hook: The instrument did not become six times quieter when I changed a threshold. I changed the observations being compared.
neid-quality-cuts.caption: Conceptual solar spectroscopy artwork. The RV figures use public NEID Level-2 metadata, not synthetic solar velocities.
glossary: Weighted mean
An average in which formal uncertainties determine relative influence.
RMS
A scatter statistic whose centring and weighting must be specified.
Reduced chi-squared
Residual size relative to the stated uncertainty model and degrees of freedom.
Structure function
A description of differences between measurements at different time separations.

detector-memory.hook: A repeatable detector trend is a result. Its physical cause is another question.
detector-memory.caption: Conceptual charge-transfer illustration. It is not a microscopic detector image or a measured radiation-damage map.
glossary: CTI
Charge transfer inefficiency: some electrons do not arrive with their original packet.
Trap
A defect that can capture charge and release it later.
Identifiability
Whether the available experiment can distinguish the parameters being fitted.
Replication
Repeating a measurement with independently selected data under a fixed procedure.

cosmic-web-surveys.hook: Before interpreting a void, check whether the survey could have put galaxies there at all.
cosmic-web-surveys.caption: Conceptual survey-slice artwork. Quantitative figures below use measured catalogue positions and redshifts.
glossary: Redshift
The fractional displacement of a spectral wavelength.
Comoving distance
A radial coordinate defined within an assumed expansion history.
Random catalogue
An unclustered catalogue reproducing the survey selection, used for comparison.
Peculiar velocity
Motion relative to the smooth cosmological expansion.

earth-shortlist.hook: A shortlist should tell us what to measure next, not pretend the missing measurements have already been made.
earth-shortlist.caption: Conceptual exoplanet artwork. Surface appearances are imagined; they are not observations of the shortlisted planets.
glossary: Habitable zone
A model-dependent range of irradiation compatible with particular surface-water conditions.
Mass-radius forecast
A conditional prediction, not a new independent mass measurement.
Occurrence rate
A population quantity requiring a survey denominator and selection model.
Evidence gap
Something not established by the available measurements, rather than evidence of absence.

coronagraph-contrast.hook: A black image is easy. Keeping the planet's photons while suppressing the star is the difficult part.
coronagraph-contrast.caption: Conceptual coronagraph illustration. The Roman OS11 figure below is separately identified as an instrument-team simulation.
glossary: Contrast
Residual stellar intensity relative to a defined stellar reference.
Throughput
The part of a source signal transmitted under a stated measurement definition.
Dark hole
A region where wavefront control suppresses coherent stellar leakage.
Regularisation
A constraint on an inverse solution that trades correction against sensitivity and actuator demand.

transit-baseline.hook: Novelty is not a performance metric. A baseline is there to make that inconvenient fact measurable.
transit-baseline.caption: Conceptual transit artwork. The benchmark figures use documented synthetic injections, not newly detected planets.
glossary: BLS
A periodic two-level search suited to short dimming events.
Injection-recovery
Add a known signal, run the pipeline, and test whether it is recovered.
Harmonic recovery
An accepted period related to the true period by a declared small integer ratio.
Empirical null
A simulated no-signal distribution of the complete search statistic.
